title: [AINews] Anthropic successfully completes largest IPO in history, valued at $1.5T
author: swyx .ai
description: November 19, 2026 — ANT went from $83 at pricing to $111.50 at the open and $97.17 at the close. Plus, Google opens Genie 4 to developers.
summary: As we previewed on our Know Before You IPO pod , Anthropic set its IPO price at $83 and today $ANT closed at $97.17, up 17% from the offering price ( drifting -5% to $92.60 after the close) . The $81.3B offering overtook SpaceX's June IPO as the largest in history.
takeaways: Product standing on IPO day: Anthropic is #1 lab on Code Arena WebDev, with Claude Fable 5.2 at 1824 , +27 over the next lab ( @arena ).
Dario and Daniela ( Dario’s remarks , Founders’ letter ) used the occasion to say Anthropic would pace training and deployment based on whether it could keep its systems safe and under human control.
Expect the lockup expiries to weigh on the stock price as about a trillion dollars of shares free up over the next year, while Anthropic has to keep the world’s top model ... for now .
